newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Evans Withycombe.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Evans Withycombe.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Sheila McGrath cut Evans Withycombe Residential Inc to hold from buy and lowered her earnings estimates on the company for the fourth quarter of 1996 and for the 1997 year.
-- She cut her fourth quarter 1996 estimate for funds from operations to $0.46 from $0.51 per share and for 1997 to $1.90 from $2.06 per share.
-- The analyst said weakness in the company's Phoenix/Tuscon markets has carried on through the fourth quarter from the third quarter.
-- "Typical fourth quarter economic occupancy pick-up has not materialized during this quarter due to over-supply in the market," she wrote.

-- "While job growth in both markets continues to be strong and exceeding national levels, we expect these markets to remain sluggish through 1997 as they continue to absorb existing supply," McGrath said.
